record.bible_text: The word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068> that came to Jeremiah<WH03414> the prophet<WH05030> against the Philistines<WH06430>, before that Pharaoh<WH06547> smote<WH05221><WTH8686> Gaza<WH05804>. <RF>Gaza: Heb. Azzah<Rf>

Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>; Behold, waters<WH04325> rise up<WH05927><WTH8802> out of the north<WH06828>, and shall be an overflowing<WH07857><WTH8802> flood<WH05158>, and shall overflow<WH07857><WTH8799> the land<WH0776>, and all that is therein<WH04393>; the city<WH05892>, and them that dwell<WH03427><WTH8802> therein: then the men<WH0120> shall cry<WH02199><WTH8804>, and all the inhabitants<WH03427><WTH8802> of the land<WH0776> shall howl<WH03213><WTH8689>. <RF>all that...: Heb. the fulness thereof<Rf>

At the noise<WH06963> of the stamping<WH08161> of the hoofs<WH06541> of his strong<WH047> <FI>horses<Fi> , at the rushing<WH07494> of his chariots<WH07393>, <FI>and at<Fi> the rumbling<WH01995> of his wheels<WH01534>, the fathers<WH01> shall not look back<WH06437><WTH8689> to <FI>their<Fi> children<WH01121> for feebleness<WH07510> of hands<WH03027>;

Because of the day<WH03117> that cometh<WH0935><WTH8802> to spoil<WH07703><WTH8800> all the Philistines<WH06430>, <FI>and<Fi> to cut off<WH03772><WTH8687> from Tyrus<WH06865> and Zidon<WH06721> every helper<WH05826><WTH8802> that remaineth<WH08300>: for the LORD<WH03068> will spoil<WH07703><WTH8802> the Philistines<WH06430>, the remnant<WH07611> of the country<WH0339> of Caphtor<WH03731>. <RF>the country: Heb. the isle<Rf>

Baldness<WH07144> is come<WH0935><WTH8804> upon Gaza<WH05804>; Ashkelon<WH0831> is cut off<WH01820><WTH8738> <FI>with<Fi> the remnant<WH07611> of their valley<WH06010>: how long wilt thou cut<WH01413><WTH8704> thyself?

O<WH01945> thou sword<WH02719> of the LORD<WH03068>, how long <FI>will it be<Fi> ere<WH03808> thou be quiet<WH08252><WTH8799>? put up<WH0622><WTH8734> thyself into thy scabbard<WH08593>, rest<WH07280><WTH8734>, and be still<WH01826><WTH8798>. <RF>put...: Heb. gather thyself<Rf>

How can it be quiet<WH08252><WTH8799>, seeing the LORD<WH03068> hath given it a charge<WH06680><WTH8765> against Ashkelon<WH0831>, and against the sea<WH03220> shore<WH02348>? there hath he appointed<WH03259><WTH8804> it. <RF>How...: Heb. How canst thou<Rf><CM>
